params.body:
The Gentells app for Android (sign-in added in #238) now also shows the member's posts and reports, and keeps the member signed in. For that it holds its own gentells.com tokens from the Observatory's first-party client. This PR adds the routes it reads, and closes a gap that holding tokens would otherwise open.

## What changes

- **`/api/app/*`**, behind `auth:api` and `throttle:120,1`:
  - `GET /api/app/posts?cursor=` lists posts, newest first, with covers.
  - `GET /api/app/posts/{id}` returns one post: the reading body the member's plan opens, otherwise the teaser plus the plan that opens the rest, the Opportunity and the evidence.
  - `GET /api/app/reports` lists reports, with covers and whether the member's plan delivers each one.
  - `GET /api/app/reports/{slug}/pages/{n}` returns a page image of a report the plan delivers, the same image the reading room renders.
- **Only for the Observatory's own client.** Each route answers a token issued to the Observatory client with the `observatory` scope, otherwise 403. The member is then read without the token's scope (`withAccessToken(null)` on a clone), so the app sees exactly what the website shows that member. These reads are not counted as agent reads against the plan.
- `Article::readingBody()` holds the rule for which body a reader gets, so the app and the site agree.
- **`/api/observatory/me` answers only the Observatory client's tokens** (`OAuthClient::issuedTheObservatory()`), otherwise 403 `wrong_client`. The pipeline's new `POST /auth/site/token` (gentells-pipeline, separate PR) turns a token into an Observatory session through this endpoint. Without the check, a member's agent granted the `observatory` scope on the consent screen could open a session with its own token. The Observatory's web login uses that same client, so it is not affected.
- `docs/design/android-app.md`: the reads and the client check.

## Paging

The cursor is the last post's publication time, parsed with `Carbon::parse` before it is compared. Compared as text, the ISO cursor sorts after SQLite's `Y-m-d H:i:s`, and the next page started with the last post of the page before. The agent API's `ReadController` (`/api/v1/posts`) still pages that way. That is left for a separate change.

## Checked

- `AppReadsTest` (6):
  - a post whole on a plan that opens it;
  - the token's one scope does not narrow the plan (reports deliverable, a page served as an image);
  - a plan below gets the teaser, and a report page it does not deliver is a 404;
  - reading in the app is not metered;
  - any other token is refused: another client even under the Observatory's name, the app's client without the scope, an account key, no token;
  - posts newest first, a page at a time, without a repeat.
- `ObservatoryAccessTest`: `/me` answers only the Observatory's own tokens.
- Full suite 535/536. `BuildStampTest` fails in any worktree because the branch ref lives in the common git dir.
- Pint passes.

## Order to go live

This PR first, then the pipeline's `POST /auth/site/token`. App 0.1.2 needs both.
params.title: Posts and reports for the Gentells app; /api/observatory/me for the Observatory client only
